eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Josephine, OR; at 6:16 PM on AUG 27, 2022 Effective until 9:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Josephine County, Rum Creek Fire. Level 3 GO continues for areas North of Galice Rd. South of the Rogue River and Lower Graves Creek Rd. East of Howard Creek. West of Hog Creek in Josephine County. For Level 3 GO area information and fire map information visit RVEM.org/Incident Info
